title: A Homecoming for the Semester
author: Orsen Lockridge
blurb: Wren Winterbourne, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
